question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**comes**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The blank in the sentence will refer to the origin of the word "democracy." 
 
• The sentence is in present tense, so we need a present tense verb to fill the blank.
 
• 'Came' is past tense, 'will come' is future tense, and 'is coming' is present continuous tense, so they are not correct options.
 
• 'Comes' is present tense and fits the sentence structure, making it the correct answer.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
